questions.questionTextEn: On the sea level, the nearest place to the center of earth is ?
questions.questionTextHi: [38th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1992] On the sea level, the nearest place to the center of earth is ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) North pole. The nearest point to the centre of the Earth lie near Arctic Ocean (at the depth of 4 km from the surface) which is at the 6353 km far from the centre of the Earth. [38th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1992]

questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following statements: 1. On the planet Earth, the fresh water available for use amounts to about less than 1% of the total water found. 2. Of the total freshwater found on the planet Earth, 95% is bound up in polar ice caps and glaciers. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2010] Consider the following statements: 1. On the planet Earth, the fresh water available for use amounts to about less than 1% of the total water found. 2. Of the total freshwater found on the planet Earth, 95% is bound up in polar ice caps and glaciers. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) 1 only. 96.5% of the total water available on Earth is salt water found in Ocean. Out of the remaining 2.5% Fresh water, 1.7% is in the form of glaciers and polar ice, which is unusable for us. So in this way total available fresh water to use is less than 1% of the total water available on earth. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2010]

questions.questionTextEn: Which one is the most extensive part of the oceanic floor?
questions.questionTextHi: [Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2012] Which one is the most extensive part of the oceanic floor?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Deep Sea Plains. A most extensive part of the oceanic floor is 'Deep sea plain'. Characterized by flat and rolling submarine plain it is the most extensive relief zone of the ocean basins. These deep- sea plains (Abyssal Plains) having the depth of 3000 m to 6000 meter cover more than 76% percent of the total area of the Ocean Basins. [Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2012]
